description: Les parkings voitures hors voirie is a dataset listed in Opendata de la Ville de Liège open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Le jeu de données présente les géolocalisations et adresses des parkings de stationnement pour les voitures. Les informations sont régulièrement vérifiées par nos services sur le terrain. Coverage: Liège. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace public. Its keywords are mobilité, voiture, parking, stationnement, pmr, vélo. The portal shows 33 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-07-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-liege-be-portal.
